propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py each exceed 800 LOC module-size CI gate cap and require architectural decomposition along existing call-graph seams rather than mechanical splitting

completion.py carries four distinct concerns (orchestration, child-closure gate, epic bug-screen floor, verdict reconciliation) that must separate into stable re-exported facades to preserve consumer imports
completion_recovery.py carries three distinct concerns (criteria/bounds/coverage, failure taxonomy, agent orchestration) that must split while keeping documented __all__ symbols accessible
epic_bug_screen.py absorbs the epic bug-screen DET layer from completion.py to unify the entire screen logic in one module
all moved symbols must remain patchable at their original dotted paths via re-export facades to avoid breaking test monkeypatch/patch strings and runtime import paths
final decomposition must yield all modules in 200-500 LOC range with zero behavior changes, passing existing test suites with only import-path and monkeypatch-target updates
